note: Family campground and marina on Lake Wappapello near Greenville, with a boat ramp campers may use, a swimming pool and cabins; the RV loop sits in woods west of the marina. --Claude
summary: Operator page: $35 E/W to $40 FHU a day (unchanged since 2024-04), 39 sites (11 FHU, 28 E/W) at 30A, showers/flush/dump/store, online booking on Vertical Booking (behind Cloudflare, unread). Google 4.4/134. Waterfront lead: lakeview looks unearned - the pads sit ~110-120 m from the shore behind woods or across the marina ramp area, and no official photo shows the lake from a site.
flags: WATERFRONT re-audit lead (stored lakeview -> not waterfront): on Esri imagery the herringbone RV loop centres ~37.0345,-90.4235; its eastmost pads (map sites 1, 3-5, 31) are ~115 m from the shoreline with a continuous wooded band between, and the northern pads are ~110-120 m from the water across the store/ramp area and marina access road. The four site photos on camping.php show only woods, no lake. The campground map's blue edge beside sites 1-5 is a brochure overview, not evidence. No source found a sightline from an RV site, so by the 2026-11-02 rule this goes down to not waterfront.

PRICE GATE: $35/night (electric/water) on the operator's page, under US$50. Presence: working website with phone 573-224-3430 and an online booking engine. Google Maps 4.4 over 134 reviews; RV Life 4* $$ (stored). The booking engine (reservations.verticalbooking.com) answered a Cloudflare challenge in the browser and was not read, so the rate was not checked against it.
Pin: 37.0361,-90.4248 sits on the access road ~200 m NW of the RV loop; suggest 37.0345,-90.4235 (centre of the loop).
Name: the operator calls it 'Holliday Landing Campground' (homepage title and Google Maps); the entry's 'Holliday Landings Resort & Marina' is not used on its pages.
